metadata.title: Intel, Amazon lead tech lower, crypto markets rattled amid $6.3 billion Binance hack: AlphaCheck

content.text:
Good morning. Stocks declined on Friday as shares of chip maker Intel (INTC) and Amazon (AMZN) led technology (XLK) and consumer discretionary (XLY) stocks lower following their quarterly results.
The declines came after Alphabet's (GOOG) (GOOGL) plunged 12% in the prior session.
Here's a check of the markets in the first few minutes of trading, based on a heat map powered by Yahoo Finance AlphaSpace data.
Crypto markets were rattled on Friday after Binance reported a breach of $6.3 bililion in what is likely the largest heist in history.
Bitcoin (BTC-USD) prices tumbled to around $77,000. Ether (ETH-USD) also dropped 4% to around $2,200. Crypto-related stocks also opened lower. Shares of Circle, trading platforms Coinbase (COIN) and Robinhood (HOOD) all tumbled. Digital-asset Treasury giant Strategy (MSTR) stock also sank.
Brent crude oil futures (BZ=F) jumped 2% to hover near $113per barrel, while WTI (CL=F) also rose to $103 ahead.
Here are some other notable stocks that Yahoo Finance readers are viewing this morning: Sandisk (SNDK), Reddit (RDDT), and ExxonMobil (XOM).
